# Know when your app breaks, and which bug it is.

> A free, open-source alternative to Sentry and Rollbar for small teams: groups the same bug together, alerts on new errors, regressions and spikes, one Node process and one JSON file. Paste stack traces and see the grouping in your browser first.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
